title: Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit Validity Extension
content:
**Larkspur Hometown Heroes Credit (Closing Cost Credit program) — extending validity**

A Hometown Heroes credit's validity is extended on request, no later than its current expiration date and while the loan file is in a status that allows extensions, and each extension raises the credit's extension count by one.

| Element | Rule |
|---|---|
| Occasion | the borrower's request |
| Timing | no later than the credit's current expiration date |
| File status | a status that allows extensions |
| Effect on the count | each extension raises the extension count by one |

### Situation of use and effect of the tool

`extend_credit_validity_45c9966f` grants one validity extension on a closing cost credit that has not yet been applied. One call adds the stated number of calendar days to the credit's current expiration date, records the new expiration date on the credit and raises the credit's count of granted extensions by one; nothing else on the credit or its ledger changes. Afterwards the desk and the borrower can see the later expiration date and the higher extension count on the credit.

### How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `extend_credit_validity_45c9966f` and then calls it.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_award_id` | Reference number of the closing cost credit whose validity is extended, as shown by the closing credit lookup for the loan file. | An identifier, as shown in the lookup. |
| `extension_days` | Number of calendar days added to the current expiration date; the new expiration date is the current expiration date plus this many calendar days. | A whole positive integer count of days, with no decimals, no unit text and no sign. |

### Return

> Validity extended: credit <credit_award_id> now expires <YYYY-MM-DD> (was <YYYY-MM-DD>); extensions granted <count>.

The dates are calendar dates in YYYY-MM-DD form and <count> is the new whole-number extension count. Receiving this line means the new expiration date is in force; the call has succeeded when the receipt is returned.

### Illustration of the contract (hypothetical values)

A credit expiring on 2026-05-30 with no extension yet, given an `extension_days` of 12, returns a receipt showing that it now expires on 2026-06-11, was 2026-05-30, and has 1 extension granted.
